planned_arguments.prompt:
Create one finished Korean plant-market promotional poster for SNS, a single flat opaque landscape image in width:height 16:9. Use case: ads-marketing. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual idea: a vivid cut-paper colony of living potted houseplants opens an irregular market passage. Substantial interlocking botanical silhouettes organize the entire image: broad split-leaf fans sweeping inward from the left, slim upright blades reaching from the top, and rounded-leaf branching stems rising from warm-pink pots at the lower right. Make individual stems clearly connected to leaves and rooted in pot mouths; intentional layered overlap keeps these attachments intelligible. Different plant scales, curved and angular cuts, and asymmetrical cropping create the feeling of choosing a varied plant community and tending it at home. Clean sharp paper-cut boundaries, controlled flat color, energetic leaf-green and deep navy with pale citron openings and restrained warm pink. Crisp graphic construction, no dimensional room, no simulated poster photograph. The plants occupy a substantial active part of the whole field and shape two adjoining interior reading spaces, rather than decorating the edges of an information rectangle.

Reading route: the date is the strongest verbal entry at the upper passage entrance, set in stable moderately heavy lining numerals. A smaller event name adjoins it; hours and venue directly below complete one compact visit cluster. Under that entry the broad left interior opening begins with the slogan in quiet emphasis and continues into a five-line upright paragraph. The last prose line faces the first access line across a short stem-led boundary into the adjoining right opening. Access, care offer, invitation and URL descend as one coherent action group. Keep the groups genuinely close enough for this lateral handoff, with a shared optical ledge between the paragraph's ending and the action group's beginning. The title is a quieter identity at the lower-left mouth of this same passage, on two meaningful lines after the third Korean syllable; its Latin companion immediately beside it. Its optical weight is distinctly below the date. Shape plant crops and opening widths together with this actual copy, keeping all letters free of leaves. No rectangular panel scaffold.

Typography: precise, mature Korean sans with squared but open counters, balanced syllable components, consistent medium stem width and even baselines. Use generous body size and normal tight editorial leading, stable left alignment and natural word spaces. Proportional Latin and lining numerals match Korean optical weight. Design for a 720-pixel-wide SNS reading situation: body and action information should remain comfortably readable, roughly a 15–17px apparent body as a planning guide, not tiny captions. Give the paragraph a broad continuous reading area; if space is tight adjust plant crops or identity scale, never squeeze prose into leaf slivers. Date and hours range dashes must appear as clearly extended midline en dashes; distinguish colons, periods and middle dots. URL stays intact on one line. Lettering is clean flat typesetting, not distressed paper texture.

Print only the following twelve entries, each once. The paragraph's soft wraps shown below form one uninterrupted entry; preserve every actual word, meaningful word space, Korean/Latin character, number and punctuation. No printed labels or entry numbers:

초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.

No extra copy, incidental lettering on pots, plant tags, logo, watermark or QR. Deliver exactly one complete poster, not multiple panels, a contact sheet or a mockup. Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information templates with subordinate small images, textures or empty-room dressing. Here the interlocking plant colony and its irregular shared passage must visibly determine the whole organization while all explanation and useful visit information remain clear.
